params.body: `hand.mjs records` asked for `#agent-workbench` on every machine. On the workbench at home it now asks for its own hand (`handFragment()`, from `hand.json`), and the ssh calls to the box allow 256 MB instead of 16, since the Mac's chain is past 9,000 steps. Tested on the workbench: 6 records, all `#agent-workbench-shed`. Proposed from the workbench at home.
